dct_description_sm: This dataset provides information about 19 gullies that were surveyed and characterized on a permafrost marine terrace near Cambridge Bay, NU, Canada. Gullies were described based on their morphology, vegetation cover, and water presence. The information in this dataset was used to investigate the formation and development of the gullies.
dct_title_s: Characteristics of gullies located on a permafrost marine terrace near Cambridge Bay, NU, Canada
